title: Have to pay for a subscription
body: After initial set up app locks up and you have to pay for a subscription to continue use, no exit button or anything nothing that lets you decide if you want to think about it later, have to pay up front before you’ve even tested it out, even though it says cancel anytime, I doubt it would let you continue to use it after you cancel your subscription, I’m not looking to pay for a planner that I’m not 100% sure I enjoy and has all that I’m looking for, so because of this I’ve decided to look elsewhere, and if you’re like me and don’t want to be pay walled I suggest you do the same, if I can’t use a free app without paying a subscription it’s not free.
author: Water bottle vodka
